sources: Arrivals 2024: Morocco 17.4M (Ministry of Tourism), Egypt 15.7M (PM Madbouly), Tunisia >10.2M non-resident visitors (prelim.) via Le360 2025; Algeria 3.548M incl. 1.093M Algerians abroad (ONAT via Algerie Eco 2025).
